Its approval language therefore does not, by itself, establish a concluded agreement, a contract award, a completed transaction, delivery or operational use. The $364 million figure should likewise be read as the estimated total cost attached to the possible sale, not as proof that this amount has been spent, received or booked. ## What would establish the next phase

A later official record would need to confirm that the process advanced beyond the notification stage before readers could describe the transaction as completed or implemented. [United States Department of State](https://www.state.gov/releases/bureau-of-political-military-affairs/2026/08/italy-guidance-section-single-variant-air-to-air-advanced-precision-kill-weapon-system-ii/). Such evidence could take the form of an official confirmation of a concluded agreement, a contract award, a delivery or another clearly identified implementation step. Until that evidence appears, the narrow conclusion remains that the State Department approved and notified Congress of a possible sale with a stated request and estimated value.
